title: Microsoft Edge: expanded enforcement controls for Data Loss Prevention connectors
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned enforcement controls from the existing connector policies, and its roadmap details match Microsoft's record. The connector discovery path could be extended to the action control, and the print policy reference should be cited for the per-action behaviour.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans expanded enforcement controls for the existing Edge for Business DLP connectors.
claims.quote: Microsoft Edge for Business is expanding its existing Data Loss Prevention Enterprise Connector capabilities.

claims.claim: The planned controls let administrators configure more consistent enforcement across download, upload, paste and print.
claims.quote: Administrators will be able to configure more consistent enforcement across download, upload, paste, and print workflows.

claims.claim: An enabled DLP connector sends content from specific user actions to an on-device agent.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Why it matters
claims.claim: Edge natively enforces DLP verdicts from the on-device agents.

claims.claim: Setting block_until_verdict to 1 makes Edge wait for the response before giving the page access to data.
claims.quote: If set to 1, Microsoft Edge waits for a response from the analysis service before giving the page access to the data.

claims.claim: Any other integer value of block_until_verdict allows immediate page access to data.
claims.quote: Any other integer value allows the page to access the data immediately.

claims.quote: GP unique name: OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector; Value name: OnFileAttachedEnterpriseConnector; Example value: [{"block_until_verdict": 0, "default_action": "allow"

claims.claim: Connector policies provide per-action verdict-waiting and communication-error fallback choices.
claims.quote: block_until_verdict If set to 1, Microsoft Edge waits for a response ... default_action If set to block, Microsoft Edge denies page access to the data if an error occurs while contacting the analysis service.
claims.fix: Add 'OnPrintEnterpriseConnector' at https://learn.microsoft.com/deployedge/microsoft-edge-policies/onprintenterpriseconnector to sources; it supports the print part of the per-action verdict-waiting and fallback statement alongside the already cited upload and paste references.
